items.question: Why extract Douyin comments for analysis?
items.answer: Comments often reveal clearer intent than video views alone. Scraped datasets help you identify pain points, objections, and content hooks faster.

items.question: How do I scrape Douyin comments in batch?
items.answer: Install MediaClaw, open a Douyin video page in desktop browser, and start scraping. The tool auto-scrolls and exports all captured fields to Excel/CSV.

items.question: Is the Douyin comment scraper free to use?
items.answer: Yes. Core scraping and export capabilities are free, which is enough for most day-to-day competitor research and content validation tasks.

items.question: How many comments should I collect per video?
items.answer: A focused sample of 300-500 recent or high-engagement comments is usually enough to detect strong patterns without creating unnecessary noise.

items.question: How can exported comments support revenue growth?
items.answer: Teams use comment data to improve offers, refine sales messaging, find recurring objections, and discover high-intent audience questions for conversion funnels.

items.question: Can I export Douyin comments to Excel or CSV?
items.answer: Yes. MediaClaw captures Douyin comment fields in a structured dataset and exports them as Excel-ready CSV, so you can analyze comments in spreadsheets, BI tools, or AI workflows.

items.question: Can MediaClaw scrape TikTok China comments?
items.answer: Yes. Douyin is commonly described as TikTok China in English search results. MediaClaw focuses on public Douyin video comment threads and exports the captured data for research and analysis.
